title: Sydney U NDE 8963
content: My mom passed away three and a half years prior to when I had this experience. I was in a dark area where my mom, myself, and a few other people I didn't know were basked in a blue-white glow. I want to say we were standing around a stone table. My mom was holding my hand and I kept wanting to leave. But she kept telling me that I had to stay for a little while longer because I needed time to get better. My mother was so beautiful and looked to be about my age, although she was 53 when she passed away. She told me that I had a beautiful baby daughter and that I had to go back because my daughter needed me. My mother eventually let me go back and I woke up. When I woke up, it took me a little while to stay awake. Then I tried to talk, but couldn't because I was intubated. I asked for a pen and paper. I asked what day it was and what time. My dad said it was the next evening. He asked why I asked. I wrote because it seemed like a lot of time had passed. I felt a great sense of gratitude that I was alive. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: August 26, 2019 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes. Illness. Childbirth. While under general anesthesia. Life threatening event, but not clinical death. I had kidney and heart failure which caused me to have flash pulmonary edema. These were complications from me having severe preeclampsia at 35 weeks of being pregnant. I was drowning. They took me into surgery for an emergency c-section under general anesthesia. I was then put into a medically-induced coma. They woke me up twenty hours later. How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Uncertain Uncertain I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. It felt more because I felt like I was using more senses then the usual five. It also felt like I didn't have a body weighing me down. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I was with my mom Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. I don't really know how to explain it but it felt like I was with my mom for a long time but yet hardly any time at all. Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Everything right in front of me seemed like my vision was seeing in 4K ultra. Back aways was fuzzy, but I think it was because I couldn't stop staring at my mom. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I don't really know. It was more like my mom was speaking to me telepathically Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes. My mom Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes It was a bluish-white glow Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. It seemed like an 'in between' or a waiting place. But I seemed aware that people who were there were from heaven or a better place. What emotions did you feel during the experience? I felt happy, relieved, and calmness Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Relief or calmness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Other Christian. I have not regularly attended church for almost 20 years Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Christian- Other Christian. I still do not attend church but fully believe there are higher beings Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists. My mom was from a heavenly place Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Slight changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Uncertain. I'm not sure After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes Because it's all just very hard to describe How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Seeing my mom again Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Five months Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes Just from what I've seen or heard on TV. It didn't affect my experience. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. I knew it wasn't a dream because it felt more real then life itself. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. Same as the previous question At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

arrival.other_being_detail: A few other people were present that she didn't know.

environment.environment_other_detail: Dark area with a blue-white glow; standing around a stone table; described as an 'in between' or waiting place; aware people there were from heaven or a better place.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe preeclampsia at 35 weeks with kidney and heart failure causing flash pulmonary edema; drowning sensation; emergency C-section under general anesthesia; medically-induced coma.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Other Christian; not regularly attended church for almost 20 years.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Described as an 'in between' or waiting place; mother held her hand and told her she had to stay a little longer to get better; told she had a baby daughter and had to go back.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel and no explicit OBE; experience begins in a dark area with blue-white glow and presence of mother/others, then return to waking in hospital.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Setting described as a dark area with a blue-white glow and a stone table; mother appeared about the experiencer's age though she died at 53; mother said she had a beautiful baby daughter and needed to return.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was in a dark area where my mom, myself, and a few other people I didn't know were basked in a blue-white glow.”
